third party expenses of enforcing any provision of any Loan Document and (ii) all amount payable
by Mortgagor under the Secured Swap Agreement, if any (all such sums being hereinafter

favor of Mortgagee on behalf of the Lenders, all of Mortgagor's right, title and interest in and to

improvements now or hereafter located thereon (the "Improvements");
